l2: 一元微分学（求导与作图）
question: 设 $f(x) = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}}$ , $f_n(x) = \underbrace{f(f(\cdots f(x)))}$ , 求 $\frac{\mathrm{d}f_n(x)}{\mathrm{d}x}$ .

steps.text: 大学生数学竞赛教程（第2版）

<<<PAGE:74>>>
分析 由于 $f_{n}(x) = f(f_{n - 1}(x))$ ，因此按复合函数求导可得到 $f_{n}^{\prime}(x)$ 与 $f_{n - 1}^{\prime}(x)$ 关系式，递推化简即可.

$$
$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\text {内} f _ {n} (x) = f (f _ {n - 1} (x)) = \frac {f _ {n - 1} (x)}{\sqrt {1 + f _ {n - 1} ^ {2} (x)}}, \text {则} \frac {f _ {n} (x)}{f _ {n - 1} (x)} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 + f _ {n - 1} ^ {2} (x)}}. \text {且有}} \\ & {\qquad \qquad f _ {n - 1} ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {f _ {n - 1} ^ {\prime} (x) \sqrt {1 + f _ {n - 1} ^ {2} (x)} - f _ {n - 1} (x) \cdot \frac {f _ {n - 1} (x) f _ {n - 1} ^ {\prime} (x)}{\sqrt {1 + f _ {n - 1} ^ {2} (x)}}}{1 + f _ {n - 1} ^ {2} (x)}} \\ & {\qquad \qquad = \frac {1}{\left[ 1 + f _ {n - 1} ^ {2} (x) \right] ^ {3 / 2}} f _ {n - 1} ^ {\prime} (x) = \left[ \frac {f _ {n} (x)}{f _ {n - 1} (x)} \right] ^ {3} f _ {n - 1} ^ {\prime} (x)} \\ & {\qquad \qquad = \left[ \frac {f _ {n} (x)}{f _ {n - 1} (x)} \right] ^ {3} \left[ \frac {f _ {n - 1} (x)}{f _ {n - 2} (x)} \right] ^ {3} f _ {n - 2} ^ {\prime} (x) = \dots} \\ & {\qquad \qquad = \left[ \frac {f _ {n} (x)}{f _ {n - 1} (x)} \right] ^ {3} \left[ \frac {f _ {n - 1} (x)}{f _ {n - 2} (x)} \right] ^ {3} \dots \left[ \frac {f _ {2} (x)}{f _ {1} (x)} \right] ^ {3} f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (x) = \left[ \frac {f _ {n} (x)}{f _ {1} (x)} \right] ^ {3} f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (x).} \end{array}
$$
$$
